description: This file defines the Polymer behavior `IronResizableBehavior`, which manages resize event coordination among Polymer elements. It includes properties, event listeners, lifecycle methods, and logic for notifying descendant elements of resize events.

methods.name: notifyResize
methods.description: Manually notifies this element and its interested resizables of a resize event.

methods.name: assignParentResizable
methods.description: Assigns the closest ancestor that implements `IronResizableBehavior`.

methods.name: stopResizeNotificationsFor
methods.description: Removes a descendant element from the list of elements to be notified of resize events.

methods.name: resizerShouldNotify
methods.description: Filter method to determine whether a descendant should be notified of resize events; default returns true.
